name: Ambient air intake
generic_type: Intake hood or louvre with debris screen
function_and_rationale: Draws air from a clean, sheltered location away from STK-101 and other heat sources. Defines the ambient reference used for density compensation (PT-100, TT-100).
design_basis: Ambient 300 K, 101.325 kPa is the design reference (the CFD inlet condition).

name: Intake filter
generic_type: Dry-media filter in a housing, with differential-pressure taps
function_and_rationale: Keeps particulates away from BLW-101, FE-101 and the 20 mm bore of TA-101. PDT-101 indicates loading and intake blockage.
design_basis: Pressure-drop allocation 100 Pa clean, 250 Pa loaded (AS-07). Filter grade and housing: TBD.
rating_and_model: Not selected; pressure drop is an allocation, not data

name: Blower
generic_type: Speed-controlled low-pressure blower; centrifugal/radial or regenerative (side-channel) types are candidates, none selected
function_and_rationale: Sole source of airflow. Flow is set by speed through VFD-101, so no throttling valve is needed in the line.
design_basis: Design point 8.69 g/s (7.38 L/s at 300 K) at fan total pressure 1278 Pa nominal (669 to 1857 Pa across the loss corners). Minimum full-speed capability 9.41 L/s at 2722 Pa, so the upper warm-ambient point (2205 Pa at 8.47 L/s, all-high losses) is reached at 90 % speed.
rating_and_model: Not selected. Shut-off pressure, rating, temperature rise and noise: vendor data required

name: Variable-speed drive
function_and_rationale: Closed-loop speed control from FIC-101. Enforces minimum and maximum speed limits (so the flow stays inside the CFD-supported range) and stops the blower on a trip from ES-101.
design_basis: Speed limits TBD from the blower characteristic and the flow envelope.

name: Pressure relief device (provisional)
generic_type: Low-pressure relief or vent device, type TBD
function_and_rationale: Limits blower-discharge pressure if the outlet is blocked and the blower shut-off pressure exceeds the lowest component rating. Kept only if the shut-off pressure shows it is needed.
design_basis: Set pressure and capacity: TBD from vendor shut-off data and the weakest component.

name: Flexible connector (blower discharge)
function_and_rationale: Isolates blower vibration from the metering run, FE-101 and the test article.
design_basis: Axial and lateral movement capacity: TBD.

name: Isolation valve
generic_type: Manual full-bore valve, lockable open, with open-position switch ZSO-101
function_and_rationale: Isolates the blower from the test circuit for maintenance. Locked open in operation. It is not a throttling device (see SYSTEM_DESCRIPTION.md s.4). ES-101 inhibits blower start unless ZSO-101 shows it open.
design_basis: Full-bore, fully open in normal operation.
rating_and_model: Not selected; sizing and rating TBD

name: Contraction adapter
generic_type: Conical reducer, line bore to 20 mm bore
function_and_rationale: Connects the line to TA-101. A conical form is preferred to an abrupt step because it lowers the loss and conditions the inlet flow. Outside the CFD domain.
design_basis: Budget uses an abrupt step as the nominal case and a 30-degree cone as the low case (AS-09).

name: Test article (heated duct)
generic_type: Existing Inconel 718 heated duct from the project: Di 20 mm, Do 40 mm, L 600 mm
function_and_rationale: The subject of the existing CFD and Mechanical work. Interface planes IF-1 (inlet) and IF-2 (outlet). Not redesigned here.
design_basis: Existing CFD: static dp 438.13 Pa, heat to air 602.755 W, outlet bulk 368.93 K at 8.66 g/s and 23.5 m/s.

name: Heater subsystem
generic_type: SEPARATE SUBSYSTEM: heater, insulation, power control and over-temperature protection
function_and_rationale: Delivers the external wall heat flux the CFD assumed (8000 W/m2 on the outer surface). Only the boundary is defined here. Heater construction, electrical rating, wiring, controls and protection are not designed and are not inferred from the heat flux.
rating_and_model: Not designed. Qualified electrical, instrumentation and heater engineers

name: Expansion adapter
generic_type: Sudden expansion (baseline) or conical diffuser, 20 mm bore to line bore
function_and_rationale: Connects the TA-101 outlet to the discharge line. The sudden expansion dissipates most of the outlet velocity pressure; a diffuser is an optimisation. Outside the CFD domain.
design_basis: Budget uses Borda-Carnot (sudden) as nominal and a 14-degree diffuser as the low case (AS-09).

name: Flexible connection (thermal growth)
generic_type: Metallic flexible element for hot service with axial travel
function_and_rationale: Absorbs the free axial growth of TA-101 so the tube is not axially restrained. Sits downstream of ADP-102, away from the hottest tube end.
design_basis: Axial travel at least 2.07 mm (largest LC1 deformation in the studied envelope) plus margin TBD. Stiffness, pressure and temperature rating: vendor data required.

name: Discharge exit
generic_type: Open discharge pipe or stack to a safe location, with guard
function_and_rationale: Free-jet exit to atmosphere. No valve, cap or restriction is permitted in the discharge path: it is the blocked-outlet safeguard. Exit position and direction set by the hot-air and hot-surface review.
design_basis: Exit static pressure is ambient (0 Pa gauge).

name: Fixed support
generic_type: Anchor at the IF-1 end of TA-101
function_and_rationale: Single axial fixed point, at the cold end. Carries weight and reacts line loads.
design_basis: Tube mass 4.63 kg (bare). Heater, insulation and flange masses TBD.

name: Guided sliding support
generic_type: Guided support at the IF-2 end of TA-101
function_and_rationale: Restrains lateral movement, allows axial growth, adds no axial restraint.

name: Rig control and monitoring system
generic_type: PLC or data-acquisition and control system
function_and_rationale: Closed-loop flow control (FIC-101), alarms, plausibility checks and data logging. Not safety-rated; trips that protect the rig are in ES-101.

name: Hardwired safety logic
generic_type: Hardwired trip and interlock chain with emergency stop HS-101
function_and_rationale: Removes heater power and stops BLW-101 on a trip, independent of CS-101 software. Trip list: PRELIMINARY_HAZARD_REVIEW.md.
design_basis: Trip inputs: PT-101, ZSO-101, PDSL-102, TSHH-120, HS-101. Performance level and architecture: TBD.
rating_and_model: Not designed. Qualified electrical and functional-safety engineer

name: Interface plane, inlet
generic_type: Inlet end plane of the heated tube
function_and_rationale: Corresponds to the CFD velocity-inlet plane. Reference plane for PT-103 and PDT-102.

name: Interface plane, outlet
generic_type: Outlet end plane of the heated tube
function_and_rationale: Corresponds to the CFD pressure-outlet plane. Reference plane for PDT-102.
